name: Lam Research
description: Lam Research builds the machines that deposit thin films onto wafers and etch circuits into them, plus equipment that cleans wafers, and sells them to chip makers. About 36% of revenue is not new machines: it is spare parts, upgrades, services and older-generation equipment for the installed base, which gives it a steadier stream than the equipment cycle. Customers are few and large: four customers were 16%, 15%, 12% and 12% of FY2026 revenue. China was 34% of revenue.
